# Bake assessment: what it would take to ship a minimal-config React framework in Bun

Tree: `oven-sh/bun` main @ `1dd66afde2` (2026-08-17). Probes ran on the canary binary built from `8326d1bd3` (22 commits behind HEAD, none of them touching bake), so probe results describe HEAD. Research only: nothing was changed, nothing was built. All `file:line` references are into this checkout; paths under `src/runtime/bake/` unless another directory is named.

Question asked: *"If we wanted to ship a maximally useful, minimal-config React framework in Bun, how do we improve and fix Bake? How much of it is salvageable? Do we need to rewrite it all?"*

## 1. Short answer

**Do not rewrite it all. Rewrite the thin top, keep the thick bottom.**

Bake is two very different things sharing a directory:

1. **A dev server** (`DevServer.rs` 6.7k + `dev_server/` 6.6k + ~4.5k lines of TS runtime/overlay, plus the two-graph bundler core and the dev module format in the parser/printer). This is shipped, load-bearing code: HTML imports, `bun ./index.html`, `Bun.serve({development:true})`, `import.meta.hot` all run on it (`server/mod.rs:311`, `HTMLBundle.rs:159-163`, `ServerConfig.rs:1059-1133`). It is the best-tested code in Bake (~190 dev test instances, every one doubling as a leak/deinit test), it is where all the 2026 hardening went (205 commits), and it already contains the framework half: a `Framework` route-bundle kind (`dev_server/route_bundle.rs:28`), server-side module evaluation and server HMR (`DevServer.rs:4214-4326` -> `hmr-runtime-server.ts`), and SSR request plumbing (`DevServer.rs:2412-2684`). The incremental graph model (nodes keyed by (side, path)) was checked specifically and is sound; the known crashes are bookkeeping bugs with fixes already written. **Verdict: keep. It cannot be deleted anyway without deleting HTML imports.**

2. **A framework product on top of it**, which is a 2024-2025 prototype that stopped moving in Sep 2025: the generic `Framework` config API (`bake.d.ts` 605 lines, `bake_body.rs` 1.5k, a duplicated keystone in `mod.rs`, `bun.app.ts`, `Bun.serve({app})`, `bun build --app`), the `bun:app` native `Response` hack (~1k native lines across parser, C++, webcore, DevServer for one feature), `FrameworkRouter` (2.1k), `production.rs` + `Bake.ts` (~1.8k, static export only), and the `bun-framework-react` preset (~1.2k TS) bound to a React build from Oct 2024. Roughly 4-5k lines of this is framework-generic indirection or port duplication that a single built-in React framework never needs, and none of it is load-bearing for anything shipped. **Verdict: this is the part to redesign, and it is small.**

Answers to the three sub-questions:

- **How much is salvageable?** By line count, most of it: all of the dev server and runtimes (~18k lines), the bundler's server-components plumbing (three-graph bundling, boundaries, proxies, manifests: it works, it has one real structural bug), the router's segment parser/matcher, the SSG driver skeleton and prerender contract, `ssr.tsx` and the hydration/navigation core of `client.tsx`, and the shipped-path test suites. What is not worth keeping: the public config surface (`app` / `Framework` / `bake.d.ts` / `bun.app.ts`), `bun:app`, `server.tsx` (an 80-line shell where every missing product feature would have to go), the in-memory `bake:/` production loader, and the multi-framework knobs (router styles, `separateSSRGraph`, `builtInModules`, per-graph JS `bundlerOptions`, the `is_built_in_react` gate).
- **Rewrite?** No. A full rewrite has to re-implement the one part that works and is protected by tests, and it does not satisfy any requirement the partial approach misses. The defects are design-era (they exist byte-for-byte in the Zig), not port-era; the port added duplication (keystone copy of the config, a third conversion in `ServerConfig.rs`, a second JSC VM in `init_bake`) but no behaviour bugs of note. That argues for fixing designs and collapsing duplicates, not re-porting.
- **What is actually missing for a framework?** Not crash fixes (about a hundred of those are already written, see section 5). The gaps are product-level and are the same under every path: (W2) an RSC binding that is not frozen on a 2024 experimental React, (W1) one structural bundler fix (server-component boundaries are registered per graph instead of per path; this is the root cause behind "anything beyond a trivial SSG fixture breaks"), (W3) a production server (today `development:false` + `app` throws a literal TODO and server chunks are never written to disk), then dynamic/ISR/`--compile`, `"use server"`, and a real preset (head/metadata, data loading, 404/500, client router). Section 6 sizes these; W3 is the only L, everything else is S/M except `"use server"`.

**Recommended path: (b)** in section 6: merge alii's seams PR (#32078) as step 0, land the ~15 quick wins (most already have branches), spike the RSC binding, fix W1, then replace L3-L6 behind a single entry point (the natural one is a `Bun.serve` route value; a prototype of exactly that has been in the tree since Feb 2025 at `server/server_body.rs:769-863`, dev-only and hard-wired to the React preset), and build the production server last on top of the HTML-import manifest precedent. Three product decisions block starting (section 8): multi-framework yes/no, pages vs app-dir convention, and where the production entry point lives.

Two things surfaced that are worth knowing independent of the decision:

- The biggest risk is ownership, not code. 2026 has 0 feature commits on bake; the original authors are gone; 103 tested fix PRs against bake are open and unreviewed (82 opened this month); and the `BUN_FEATURE_FLAG_EXPERIMENTAL_BAKE` env var has been a stub returning `false` since the Rust port (`bun_core/lib.rs:2340-2348`, `feature_flags.rs:5,130`) without anyone noticing, which means the 1.4.0 release as it stands makes `--app` and `Bun.serve({app})` unreachable on stable entirely (fix is open: #38445).
- `bun:app` is reachable from any script on any build and `new Response(<jsx-like>)` outside a dev server segfaults (reproduced: SIGSEGV at 0x108, exit 139). Section 6 Q7.

## 3. Part B: Per-layer salvage verdicts

Absolute roots: `/workspace/bun/src/runtime/bake/` (DevServer.rs, dev_server/, FrameworkRouter.rs, production.rs, bake_body.rs, mod.rs, bake.d.ts, hmr-*.ts, client/, bun-framework-react/, *.cpp), `/workspace/bun/src/bundler/` (bundle_v2.rs, ServerComponentParseTask.rs, LinkerGraph.rs, linker_context/), `/workspace/bun/src/js/builtins/Bake.ts`, `/workspace/bun/src/jsc/bindings/JSBakeResponse.cpp`, `/workspace/bun/src/runtime/webcore/BakeResponse.rs`, `/workspace/bun/src/runtime/server/{ServerConfig.rs,server_body.rs,HTMLBundle.rs,mod.rs}`, `/workspace/bun/test/bake/`.

### L1: DevServer + IncrementalGraph + dev format + HMR runtime + overlay -> **KEEP (generic core) / KEEP-WITH-FIXES (framework half)**

- **Size:** DevServer.rs 6,706 + dev_server/ 6,629 (incremental_graph.rs 1,911) + source_provider_exports.rs 170 + BakeSourceProvider.cpp 171 / DevServerSourceProvider.cpp 17 + TS runtime ~4.5k + overlay.css 341 + bake-codegen.ts 213 ≈ 18.5k lines. Zig predecessor ~9.8k for the Rust 13.3k; growth is 207 `SAFETY:` comments and borrowck reshaping (Zig-style `'brk:` blocks, `// errdefer` residue `DevServer.rs:808, :3512`, pasted Zig at `serialized_failure.rs:250-266`).
- **Load-bearing:** yes, `server/mod.rs:311, :2208-2237`; `HTMLBundle.rs:159-163, :274-297`; `ServerConfig.rs:1059-1133`; `frontend_only` switch `DevServer.rs:538-544, :917-919, :1343-1350, :4214`. Codegen embeds bake.client.js 48.5 KB / bake.error.js 23.8 KB / bake.server.js 11 KB in every binary; `import.meta.hot` is public API (`packages/bun-types/devserver.d.ts`).
- **Framework-only slices (~2.0-2.2k lines):** `compute_arguments_for_framework_request :2412-2597`, `on_framework_request_with_bundle :2599-2684` and the 8-arg `handleRequest` contract (`:2665-2682` ↔ `hmr-runtime-server.ts:25-45`), `make_array_for_server_components_patch :3655`, server patch eval `:4214-4326`, router scan/InsertionHandler `:922-1004, :5843-5930`, `Response.render` support `:6285-6706`, `hmr-runtime-server.ts` (198 lines), BakeSourceProvider server-patch loading. Generic: HTML routes, assets, source maps, HMR socket, error reporting, CSS lists, watcher.
- **Structural problems:** 211 `unsafe` tokens in DevServer.rs (raw `*mut RouteBundle`/dev_ptr reborrows `:2605-2663, :4293-4305`; `MaybeUninit` transpilers with SSR bitwise-aliasing server `:400-402, :705-719`; container_of `owner()` `incremental_graph.rs:318-325`); `finalize_bundle` is one 1,060-line fn `:3801-4864`; abort sites `:4270-4323` (open PR #37794 implies a throwing server module during hot update reaches them); TODOs `:1001, :1290, :1828-1836, :1985, :2036, :5720, :5748, :5806, :6156, :6674, :5885`; one bundle in flight `:229-264`; root always cwd (`ServerConfig.rs:1072-1075`); `reload()` ignores new bake config (`server_body.rs:2396`); tombstones never reused (`incremental_graph.rs:531-534`); recursive traces (`:1172, :1279`); 7 `Output::panic` sites (~:567, 620, 738, 756, 1106, 1134, 1206) of which `:1134` is user-reachable (row 6); dead SSR dual-index tracking `:836-843` (inherited from Zig); visualizer/dump-on-crash lost in port (`DevServer.rs:5447/:5460` empty; restore PRs #38664/#38617); `bun:wrap` helper gap (#38737: decorators fail in every dev server); test-only wire protocol ungated in product (`dev_server/mod.rs:112/:127`, `hmr_socket.rs:191-230`, `debug_assert!(false)` states `mod.rs:717`); H3 excluded (`HTMLBundle.rs:275-293`); vtable seam protected only by debug ThreadLock (`bun_core/util.rs:2060-2065`); dead visualizer HTML files in tree.
- **Dev format / transforms:** printer `print_dev_server_module` `js_printer/lib.rs:6602-6778` (19 InternalBakeDev sites), `lower_esm_exports_hmr.rs` 769 lines; standalone `--format=internal_bake_dev` has a namespace-import + `export *` bug (probed) and is test/debug-only surface; open ESM-semantics issues #29747 (fix #29749 open since April), #34733 are L fixes, not architecture.
- **Coverage:** strong for the shipped half (html/hot/css/esm/bundle/sourcemap/stress/vfile/plugins tests; ~190 test instances; every dev test doubles as a deinit/leak test via `getDevServerDeinitCount`); thin for the framework half (one server-reload browser test; zero nested-boundary, SSR-error, or source-map-staleness tests); `esm.test.ts:328` CI-skipped (report_error hang).
- **Maintenance:** 205 commits (2024=22, 2025=104, 2026=79); 2026 = hardening only (robobun #36247, #37517, #35008, #30977, #30977 being release-only suggests no release-mode CI run).
- **Dependence on rest of Bake:** consumes `bake::Framework` (2 fields in HTML mode), FrameworkRouter (framework mode only), `bake_types` view of the bundler. #32078 would reduce bundler↔bake to `FrameworkBundleOptions` + the 11-slot `DevServerHandle` vtable + 2 hooks, server↔bake to an erased slot + 6-slot vtable.
- **Verdict backing:** two independent passes over the boundary model and the graph rate the (side, path) node model sound; the crashes are bookkeeping bugs with queued fixes; it is the best-tested code in Bake; deleting it deletes HTML imports.

### L2: Bundler server-components machinery -> **KEEP-WITH-FIXES** (one structural fix)

- **What/size:** `bake_types` `bundle_v2.rs:353-679`; `BakeOptions :152-157` wired `:2857-2885` (only DevServer and `generate_from_bake_production_cli :4053-4131` construct it; `Bun.build` has no SC option); `Target::ServerComponentsSsr` (`ast/target.rs:19`) threaded through resolver/CSS/printer/chunk naming; per-target path maps `Graph.rs:69`; `ssr:` prefix `:7595-7610`; manifest block `:3316-3560`; SCB block `:7152-7293`; `ServerComponentParseTask.rs` 397; `StaticRouteVisitor.rs:20-22` ("dumbest way… false negatives", it actually decides hydration, #38340); `generateChunksInParallel.rs:1240-1248` entry_point_index = source_index−3 hack (plugin-resolved routes can misattribute, by reading), `:1262-1268` `is_built_in_react` gate. The Framework config exists as five projections (bake_body, keystone `mod.rs:128-190` with a second `init_transpiler :200-330`, bundler `:455`, resolver `resolver/options.rs:196-198`, parser `parser.rs:126-142`).
- **Load-bearing split:** two-graph server+browser core (`:3076-3090`, `:1563-1610`, `:238-269`, `Graph.rs:79`, `Chunk.rs:443-445`) is shipped HTML imports; only SSR graph + directives + SCB + proxies + manifests are Bake-only, and those are hard-wired to a `Framework` (`unwrap()`s `ParseTask.rs:2538`, `bundle_v2.rs:7154-7160, :2570-2577, :6118`, SCPT `:251-258`), so "bundler SC on its own" still needs an internal constant Framework value.
- **Defects:** rows 6/7; `todo_panic!`s `:3388, :3513, :7194`; `chunks: []`; `import_bun_app` miscompile (parser `p.rs:2913-2930`/`:1732-1736`, asserted as expected output by `response-to-bake-response.test.ts:47-51, 96-101`); `bun build --server-components` documented (`docs/snippets/cli/build.mdx:250-252`, `Arguments.rs:528`) and crashes on every input (`build_command.rs:500-563` discards the client transpiler; unwraps at `bundle_v2.rs:264`/`ThreadPool.rs:740`/`:6118`; first hit with `"use client"` `ParseTask.rs:2535-2541`; #38046 converts to an error); per-rebuild AstAlloc leak (`DevServer.rs:3270`, #39050) and SCPT task-box leak (#38004) by reading.
- **Coverage:** zero direct bundler tests (`expectBundled` serverComponents plumbing unused); only via test/bake.

## 4. Part C: The structural question

**What the HTML-import foundation gives a framework for free (all shipped):** dev server + HMR + overlay (L1); CSS/asset pipeline; plugins via bunfig `[serve.static]` (`server_body.rs:1050`; same handle passed to all graphs `DevServer.rs:3228`); env/define plumbing (`ServerConfig.rs:1106-1131`); production as either runtime bundling (`HTMLBundle.rs` non-dev branch) or AOT manifest (`bun build --target=bun` → `HTMLImportManifest.rs` → `server_body.rs:534-652`, standalone `:566-570`, #20265) with `--compile`; `bun ./index.html` (`src/js/internal/html.ts`, `run_command.rs:1091, :2523-2548`); typed `serve.d.ts`; docs; tests; Bun.serve routes (API routes, per-method, `:params`, `{dir}` DirectoryRoute #36156). **What it lacks:** a server entry/route-module concept at runtime in prod, routing convention, server graph + RSC rendering in prod, prerender, server bundle output, server-side HMR runtime (exists only in Bake's framework half).

**What the HTML path already depends on (undeletable on any path):** DevServer + dev_server/* (incl. `IncrementalGraph<Server>` and a server transpiler, built unconditionally `DevServer.rs:546, :671-692`), `BakeOptions`-shaped bundle entry (`:3213-3239`), HMR client/error runtimes + overlay + codegen, printer/parser dev transforms, `bake::UserOptions`/`Framework::auto`/`SplitBundlerOptions`/`FileSystemRouterType` types, the two-graph bundler core.

**The `{dir, style}` seam:** it is the concrete remnant of the stated intent, `ServerConfig.rs:1297`'s comment was written in f912e0abc4 (2025-02-08, #16955, which put HTML imports on DevServer), and f17ce2b756 (2025-02-12) added the route-value prototype four days later; corroborated by `feature_flags.rs:126-127` ("HTML loaders and … bunfig.toml"), `DevServer.rs:1982` (Framework plugins "likely going to be phased out"), and f4339df16b (Jul-2025) making prod React-only. It already funnels into the same `UserOptions→DevServer` path as HTML routes. Missing to make it real: prod support (`:1135-1139`), configurability (`:835-837`), typing, tests, route-key/prefix honoring (`server/mod.rs:2585`), and a gate or removal meanwhile.

**Essential vs indirection if Bun ships exactly one React framework:**

| Abstraction | Tag | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Three-graph bundling, SCB list, reference proxies, manifests | essential (internal) | `bundle_v2.rs:7152-7293, :3316-3560`, `ServerComponentParseTask.rs` |
| Route→bundle mapping, `Data::Framework`, server patch, `hmr-runtime-server` contract | essential (internal) | `route_bundle.rs:28-33`, `DevServer.rs:2412-2684, :4214-4326` |
| Prerender driver contract (render/prerender/getParams) | essential (reshape) | `Bake.ts`, `production.rs:856-896` |
| A production routes manifest + server runtime | essential, ABSENT | §6 W3 |
| react-refresh wiring (auto-detect) | essential | `bake_body.rs:573-603` |
| Root dir, define/env/conditions/loader/plugins, outdir | essential user config | row 19; `ServerConfig.rs:1106-1131` |
| Internal constant `Framework` value | essential until bundler unwraps are removed | `ParseTask.rs:2538`, `bundle_v2.rs:6118` |
| User-facing `Framework` object, `Framework::from_js`, bake.d.ts, bun.app.ts | indirection | `bake_body.rs:750-1102`, `production.rs:291-395` |
| `builtInModules` as user option (keep embedding mechanism internally) | indirection | `bake.d.ts:102`, `bake_body.rs:511-524` |
| `separateSSRGraph` toggle | indirection (React needs `true`; `false` is prod-unimplemented, one dev fixture) | `bundle_v2.rs:3388`, `p.rs:7644` |
| Router styles, JS-defined style, 256 types, per-type entrypoints/extensions, `prefix` | indirection | `FrameworkRouter.rs:615-663`, `bake_body.rs:935-938` |
| `reactFastRefresh.importSource`, per-graph `bundlerOptions` JS split, `staticRouters` | indirection | `bake_body.rs:207-217, :486/:545` |
| `is_built_in_react` / `BakeExtra` gate | indirection (becomes constant or disappears) | `generateChunksInParallel.rs:1262-1268`, `production.rs:793` |
| `bun:app` native Response + parser rewrite | indirection (JS convention suffices) | L5b |
| `UserOptions` arena/StringRefList + keystone duplicates + third conversion | port artifact | `bake_body.rs:105-135`, `mod.rs:66-592`, `ServerConfig.rs:688-726` |

**Answer:** build on the foundation, the framework becomes a Bun.serve route value (plus bunfig options and an import-based or bunfig marker for AOT builds), reusing L1 and L2 as internals; the `app`/Framework API, bake.d.ts, bun.app.ts and bun:app are deleted rather than fixed. Two caveats: the bundler's SC support is not usable without an internal Framework value (L2), and whether `BundleV2` can host HTML-import multi-target (`initialize_client_transpiler`) and `BakeOptions` in one build is asserted from structure (`bundle_v2.rs:238-269, :2857-2885`), not sized, it is the main technical unknown of path (b) (§8).

By year: 2024 = 32 (all features caruso), 2025 ≈ 140 (caruso feature era to May; Zack SSG 0b9bab34d8/f4339df16b/a89e61fcaa Jul-Sep), 2026 = 107 classified **0 feature / ~29 bugfix / ~8 pass-through / ~74 mechanical** (±3). **Queued fix branches (decisive for path (a) cost).** 113 branches on origin → 110 PRs: 103 open (82 opened in 2026-08), 7 self-closed dupes; all but 3 carry tests; zero human review except alii on #39302/#37779/#39150 and Jarred bot commands on #36812/#37051 (8 of 103 touched by a human); ~9 functional bake merges to main since June. The queue already fixes: layouts #38336, getParams + prerender hang #33216, static header #33222, client→client proxy #38252, `import()`/`import *` of client modules #38238/#38227, cycle hydration #38340, shared CSS #37051, custom-framework gate #32143, router panics #39174/#39301/#31697, flag #38445, ignoreDirs #38234, `--server-components` error #38046, port regressions #38664/#38617/#38737, dev SCB crashes #31697/#37850, dispose/accept #37773/#37785, leaks #39050/#38004, leaksan #39293. **Residual after merging everything:** `import_bun_app` miscompile, `bun:app` segfaults and semantics, the per-path SCB dedupe root cause (queue fixes symptoms), `--outdir`/flag handling, bundlerOptions honoring (queue has 3 duplicate *validation* branches), RSDB freeze, "use server", production server/dynamic/ISR/`--compile`, metadata/data-loading product features, stale-SSR-after-client-edit, server error overlay, route add/remove, docs/types. Reading: the queue is a resource for the dev half and the panic list, but review bandwidth, not code, is the binding constraint; that is itself the strongest evidence against "just fix it incrementally".

**Prior art.** zack/ssg-prod-copy (PR #23157, open draft, 2025-10-15): manifest.json + `Bun.serve({app, development:false})` + embedded runtime calling `render()`; broken at tip (ABI mismatch, red CI); Zig/C++ not portable; TS runtime (~60-line delta from hmr-runtime-server.ts) and 10 tests reusable. ali/react (PR #22504, self-closed 2026-01-05 in a stale sweep; "wip" body, no human review): preset moved to an npm package, public app.d.ts, client split with prefetch, two native fixes still missing in Rust (gate; isolated-hash for empty entry chunks), vendored 2025-09 rsdb without recipe; an rsdw experiment was reverted the next day (bb19610f0d/ecd2fed665); its TS hunks still apply. ali/decouple-bake-3-seams (#32078, parts 1-2 merged 2026-06-10/11): pure motion, merge-tree clean on HEAD (not compiled), crisp seams around L1, does not isolate L2.

### Structural work items (shared vocabulary for the paths)
- **W1 per-path SCB dedupe**, M. Root cause of prod rows and the dev crash family (`bundle_v2.rs:7152-7169/:7279-7282`, `LinkerGraph.rs:740-764`); keeps IncrementalGraph unchanged. Also decide `separateSSRGraph:false` (delete, M) and fill `chunks[]` (S).

- **W3 production server**, L (revised from XL). Q6; write server+SSR chunks unconditionally (`production.rs:702-725`); emit a routes manifest on the `HTMLImportManifest` precedent (`server_body.rs:534-652`); runtime = hmr-runtime-server.ts delta; serve prerendered pages as FileRoutes and `/*` → `render()`; reuse #23157's tests as spec. Depends on Q6, W2; W1 for client components inside SSR routes (the L-vs-XL swing, §8). Stays XL only if bundled with W4+W5 or built as the prototype's native Manifest layer.
- **W4 dynamic mode + ISR + `--compile`**, M each, after W3 (plumb `Mode::ProductionDynamic`; per-route `mode`; revalidate cache; standalone precedent `:566-570`).

- **W6 preset → product**, M-L: rewrite server.tsx (head/metadata, layouts with data, async data loading, 404/500, action hook), keep ssr.tsx, client router from `client.tsx:270-325` + ali/react router/link, first nav/hydration tests. Depends on W2.
- **W7 router convention**, S-M for pages (sort/specificity, prefix, aliases as errors, add/remove at runtime = M) or L for app-dir (Route model, Extra kinds, groups, metadata files); delete styles/JS-style/256 types either way.
- **W8 config seam**, M: one route value (+ bunfig) replacing `app`/Framework/bun.app.ts; collapse keystone/body/ServerConfig duplication; honor root/define/conditions/loader/plugins/env/outdir; ideally after Q13.
- **W9 `bun:app` → JS convention**, S-M (~30 edit sites; keep or drop `Response.render` rewrite = the only non-trivial native piece, `DevServer.rs:6285-6706`).
- **W10 dev framework-half hardening**, M aggregate: stale SSR after client edit, server error overlay (`serialized_failure.rs:184-198`, `error-serialization.ts:34-41`), per-patch source-map URLs (`BakeSourceProvider.cpp:65/:87`), shared-module staleness, dispose semantics, exit-code-1 after errored request, route add/remove.
- **W11 tests/docs/types**, L: offline deps; nested-boundary, CSS-in-client, layout-prod, nav, hydration tests; docs (none exist); public types (app.d.ts as reference only).

### Paths
**(a) Incremental fix, keeping the generic Framework API.** Order: merge queue (~100 PRs) → Q-list → W1, W2 → Q10 + unify the five Framework projections and the keystone duplicates (M) → W3 generic across frameworks (prerender contract per framework, `separateSSRGraph:false` implemented rather than deleted: +M) → W4-W6 → W10, W11, plus reconciling bake.d.ts with reality (M). Risks: the review-bandwidth evidence (§5) says this path has been stalled since June with the code already written; genericity multiplies every prod item (the only generic consumer is one Svelte dev fixture); React-only special cases (`is_built_in_react`, `production.rs:793`, `server_body.rs:835`) persist; public surface (bake.d.ts, bun.app.ts, bun:app) would be committed to as-is; RSDB freeze identical to other paths.

**(b) Keep L1 + L2 plumbing + HTML foundation; rewrite L3/L4/L5/L6 as one built-in framework (recommended).** Order: Q13 (#32078) and the crash/stable-exposure quick wins (Q1-Q3, Q5-Q9, Q11, Q15) → W2 spike → W1 → W8 + W7 + W9 (new seam; delete `app`, bake.d.ts, bun.app.ts, bun:app, styles, separateSSRGraph, builtInModules option, BakeExtra gate) → W6 → W3 → W4 → W5 → W10 throughout → W11. Risks: regressing HTML imports while touching the framework half of DevServer/BundleV2 (mitigated by the strong shipped-path suites, but the BundleV2 dual multi-target cost is unsized, §8); entry-point product decision needed up front; dev framework-half guards are thin (ssg-pages-router, react-response, production.test.ts) until W11; dev/prod contract divergence must be designed out once (getParams prod-only, Response dev-only, plugins); RSDB ownership; Windows untested (`FrameworkRouter.rs:288-314` stack use; prod path).

**(c) Full rewrite.** Cannot delete L1 or the two-graph bundler core (HTML imports), so "full" means (b) plus re-implementing ~13k lines of dev server + graph + ~5k lines of runtime/transforms that are the best-tested (≈190 tests), most-hardened (205 commits, all 2026 bugfix work) code in Bake, which two independent passes rated architecturally sound. XL with no requirement row it uniquely satisfies; it would re-expose the UAF/deinit class fixed throughout 2026 and restart the ESM-semantics bug tail (#29747/#34733 are L fixes inside the existing format). Only justified if the dev module format or IncrementalGraph model were wrong, the boundary-model review found the opposite (dev is keyed correctly; bugs are bookkeeping). Reject.

### Recommendation
Path (b). Roughly: ~15 S quick wins (most pre-written), W1/W2 as the two M-sized enablers, W3 as the one L that makes it a real framework, W6-W9 as the M-sized product rewrite of the thin layers, W4/W5 afterwards, W11 continuously. Of Bake, salvage ≈ all of L1 (~18k lines), the L2 plumbing, the router's parser/matcher, the SSG skeleton, ssr.tsx and the client core, and the shipped-path tests; discard ≈ the config API, bun:app, server.tsx, the chunk-in-memory prod loader, and the framework-generic indirection (§4 table), on the order of 4-5k lines, none of it load-bearing.

**Evidence that would change this:**
- Third-party frameworks are a product requirement (only consumer today: `test/bake/fixtures/svelte-component-islands`) → (a) with type unification first, and W3 must be generic.
- `BundleV2` cannot host a server graph behind an HTML-style route value without major linker surgery → keep an `app`-shaped *internal* config but still delete the public surface (b′); recommendation otherwise unchanged.
- Nobody can own an RSC binding (W2 fails) → RSC is deferred on every path; the framework becomes SSR/SPA on the HTML foundation, which strengthens (b) and removes W5.
- Client components inside prod-SSR routes still fail after Q6+W1 → W3 becomes XL; the path is unchanged but the schedule is not.
- The queue starts merging quickly → the dev half of (a) becomes nearly free, but W3-W5/W6/W11 are identical under (a) and (b), so (b) still wins on surface area unless genericity is required.
- "use server" turns out M via RSDW's existing action plumbing → shorter timeline, same path.
- Shipped-path issue volume (≥16 unlabeled 2026 issues) keeps growing → more of the budget goes to L1 on any path; it never argues for (c).

## 7. Cross-cutting concerns

1. **Ownership vacuum, not code quality, is the dominant risk:** 0 feature commits in 2026, original authors gone, 103 tested fix PRs unreviewed, the flag silently dead since the port without anyone noticing.
2. **Stable-build exposure today:** `bun:app` segfaults (ungated), `{dir,style}` ungated dev entry, test-only HMR wire protocol ungated, `--server-components` documented and crashing, `--app` onboarding text containing "TODO", docs documenting flags compiled out of stable.
3. **Dev/prod divergence is systemic:** `getParams` prod-only; `Response` rewrite works only under HMR; `separateSSRGraph:false` dev-only; dev ignores sourcemap/minify while prod honors them; plugins tested dev-only; asset naming differs. Any design must define one contract executed by both runtimes (W3's runtime should be the same module as the dev one, as the prototype did).
4. **Bugs are design-era; duplication is port-era.** Decide on that basis: fix designs (W1, W8), collapse duplicates (keystone/body/ServerConfig), do not re-port.
5. **Test coverage is inversely proportional to salvage risk:** the layers proposed for rewrite (L3-L6) are the least tested, so rewriting them loses little; the layers proposed to keep are protected.
6. **Everything RSC-shaped hangs on an external dependency** (binding ownership); schedule W2 first so the rest is not built on the frozen 2024 build.
7. **Locked-in quirks to consciously keep or break:** `string | string[]` params, the 4-byte CSS-list framing, the `Accept: text/x-component` negotiation, the `import.meta.hot` public API (must be preserved), the `{dir}` DirectoryRoute namespace now shared with `{dir,style}`.

## 8. Open questions that block action

**Product decisions (not answerable from code):**
- Is multi-framework support a goal? (Selects (a) vs (b); affects W3 genericity.)
- Routing convention: pages+`_layout` (works now; W7 = S-M) vs app-dir (W7 = L, metadata files, Extra kinds).
- Production entry point: Bun.serve route value (prototype `{dir,style}`; consistent with §4), `Bun.serve({app, development:false})` (#23157's tests; the surface slated for removal), or an emitted `dist/server.js`. All attach at `ServerConfig.rs`/`server_body.rs` lines cited; W3/W8 cannot start without this.
- Options surface: bunfig `[serve.*]` (the 2025 intent; wired into both runtimes today) vs options on the route value.
- React stable vs experimental (forces RSDW-or-equivalent vs owning a fork); keep `Response.render` rewrites at all (decides whether `DevServer.rs:6285-6706` survives W9).
- Is the robobun queue meant to be consumed? (Sets path (a)'s real cost and the quick-win list's status.)

**Technical unknowns:**
- Cost of hosting HTML-import multi-target and `BakeOptions` server-graph bundling in one `BundleV2` (`bundle_v2.rs:238-269, :2857-2885`; 23 linker files reference bake), the main (b) risk; needs a spike.
- Whether #32078 compiles on HEAD (18 overlapping files changed since its base; textually clean).
- Exact `bun:app` segfault site (debug build), and whether `BUN_JSC_validateExceptionChecks` asserts at `VirtualMachine.rs:3423`.
- Whether `"use client"` inside a prod-SSR route works after Q6 + W1 (decides W3 L vs XL); what the prototype's unlabeled "damn" commit 2173d308d6 worked around.
- Location/recipe of any react-server-dom-bun source; whether upstream's node-unbundled client already uses `import()` (only affects whether an SSR-side shim is needed).
- Root causes not traced: stale SSR after client edit (hypothesis: `incremental_graph.rs:836-843`), exit code 1 after an errored dev request, the 1.3 MB post-error `u` frame, `esm.test.ts:328` report_error hang, the "pre-existing SSR/SSG gaps" #32078 refers to, whether CI ever runs test/bake in release mode, the `deinitialization.test.ts` flake rate.

**Claims resting on code reading / artifacts only (not executed), to treat as high-confidence-but-unreproduced:** static-build navigation mis-framing (header bytes verified, browser not run); `production.rs:1011` styles holes; cross-patch server source-map staleness (frame mis-attribution was observed, mechanism inferred); `css-reloader.ts:154-161` empty-placeholder edge; shared-module staleness (wire-level only); plugin execution on client/SSR graphs in prod (server graph verified); `entry_point_index` misattribution with plugin-resolved routes; the `incremental_graph.rs:514` demotion debug_assert path in release; stable-binary gating (source + a 1.3.14 Zig-era probe, no stable build of HEAD); #32078 compile status; #14324/#14763 checkbox counts (single API success); sizes for W5 in particular are judgement calls.
